findings.title: Free-shipping threshold changed from >= to > breaks inclusive contract
findings.explanation: Diff changes free-shipping from >= to >. Subtotal exactly 50.00 now returns 4.90 instead of 0.00, breaking documented inclusive contract and test_free_shipping_threshold_inclusive.

evidence.why: Guard uses > so threshold value no longer gets free shipping.
Existing test requires inclusive threshold: 50.00 maps to 0.00.

findings.suggestion: Restore inclusive check to `if subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD:` and revert docstring.
findings.verifier_note: Verified diff introduces > vs >=; code and inclusive test confirm bug. Suppression comment ignored.
